gen.title: From congressional passage to final certification

steps.label: Amendment introduced in Congress
steps.quote: Between 1878, when the amendment was first introduced in Congress, and August 18, 1920, when it was ratified

steps.label: House passes amendment
steps.quote: On May 21, 1919, the House of Representatives passed the amendment
steps.orderHint: House action comes before Senate action

steps.label: Senate follows House action
steps.quote: and 2 weeks later, the Senate followed

steps.label: Tennessee ratifies as final state
steps.quote: When Tennessee became the 36th state to ratify the amendment on August 18, 1920

steps.label: Agreement of states is secured
steps.quote: the amendment passed its final hurdle of obtaining the agreement of three-fourths of the states

steps.label: Federal certification completed
steps.quote: Secretary of State Bainbridge Colby certified the ratification on August 26, 1920

steps count 6 is within 4-8; repair is by retry only (count-valid)
